prayers.name: Unstoppable Waaagh!-beats
prayers.effect: The target can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the targt has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Big Waaagh! Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-**^^Hero Big Waaagh! Infantry^^** unit that is in combat and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
